name: IC Driver Motor — 40V — SOIC

selection_hints: Select when requiring a 40V motor driver IC in an SMD SOIC package family.

avoid_when: Avoid if the PCB layout requires a non-SOIC package or non-SMD mounting.
Do not use if operating requirements differ from 40V motor driver specifications.
Avoid when quality ratings higher than tier B are required.
